scenario: okf adapter placement -- the adapter is CONSUMER-ONLY in 0.9.0 (§5), so it has no placeNew. Mirrors placement/all-types.json's envelope with a read-only marker, matching the website-snapshot family's shape for the same reason (no adapter-owned placement).
adapterStatus: IMPLEMENTED — src/core/adapter/adapters/okf-adapter.ts. Authoring/placement is deliberately absent (§5: 'authoring: consumer-only in 0.9.0. AKM-specific write commands fail before touching an OKF target.').
specSource: docs/architecture/specs/akm-0.9.0-bundle-adapter-spec.md §5 ('authoring: consumer-only in 0.9.0'), §2 (placeNew is OPTIONAL on BundleAdapter), §7 (okf adapter row: 'writable: yes' at the BUNDLE level, meaning an OKF *source* CAN be configured writable=true, but the adapter itself never places a new concept -- AKM-native write commands are rejected before touching disk regardless of the source's writable flag; see the runbook's §10 write-rejection contract).
realWorldSource: tests/integration/okf-conformance.test.ts's write-rejection block (originally :832-936) -- akm remember / createWorkflowAsset / writeMarkdownAsset all reject an OKF-adapter target with 'adapter "okf" ... does not support AKM asset writes' before any file is created
notes: okfAdapter.placeNew is undefined -- there is no on-disk placement for any type within an OKF component. Every AKM-native write command (createWorkflowAsset, writeMarkdownAsset, akm remember, promoteProposal, ...) is rejected by assertAkmAssetWrite BEFORE touching disk when the resolved write target's adapterId is 'okf' -- see the runbook's write-rejection contract (Rule 5 / §10) and D2 (#730)'s explicit scope note that the new v0.2 provenance-stamping write path is AKM-native-only and never reaches an OKF target for the same reason.

This is a deliberate DIFFERENCE from writable native adapters (akm, akm-workflow, akm-task, dotenv, llm-wiki, claude, opencode, agent-skills), all of which implement placeNew. OKF and website-snapshot are the two read-only/consumer-only adapters in the BUILTIN_ADAPTERS registry.

*.note: no placement for ANY open type value -- OKF's type is unbounded (any non-empty frontmatter string), and none of them get adapter-owned placement. AKM-native write commands fail before creating or changing a file, regardless of the target's writable flag.
